# `conflicting-build-options`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports one root source configured with different target or optimization options
across compile units.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Comptime evaluation and available declarations can differ by build options,
producing inconsistent analysis and behavior from the same root.

## When it fires

It is a project scan rule that compares explicit build configurations for the
same normalized root path.
